title: Electro: electro-funk / breakbeat electro (808, robot leads) and electro house (filtered saw bass, pumped supersaw stabs, clap builds)
doc: F minor, 120-130 bpm, one cycle = one bar on 16 steps. Electro-funk: 808-style kick, clap and cowbell, syncopated synth bass, formant (vocoder-style) leads and stabs. Electro house: four-on-the-floor, a resonant filtered saw bass, supersaw stabs pumped by the kick (kickPump), clap builds.

section.title: DnB, electro, house / techno / trance: kits, forms, feels
section.explain: Pack glyphcore/dnb-electro (docs/CONVENTIONS.md 8-11, sources in docs/DNB_ELECTRO_REFERENCES.md). F minor throughout, one cycle = one bar of 4/4 on 16 steps. Components are racks (band-scoped, docs/RACK_STANDARD.md; per-role classes reese, neuro, break, gate) and pattern atoms (dnb. drum-and-bass, el. electro, hs. house / techno / trance / big room, tn. tension and release); forms are gate atoms (dnb.intro .. dnb.outro on a 128-bar DnB form, el.* and hs.* on 8-bar sections, hs.map* on a 160-bar club map of 32-bar blocks); breaks are synthesised and chopped by re-sequencing the 16 slices of a bar (.bite(16, atoms.dnb.chops)); sidechain is first-class (kickPump moves the superdough duck onto the bass, chord and pad orbits; kickDuck wires a gain to kick:env). Seven feel templates (feel-liquid, -neuro, -jumpup, -electrohouse, -techno, -trance, -bigroom) fill the same slots as the phonk feels; their grooves are compositions of the standard presets (groove-swing | groove-push | groove-human with the voice seed).

atomsIngredient.title: Electro atoms
atomsIngredient.doc: glyphcore/dnb-electro electro atoms (el.): electro-funk 808 kick, clap, hats and cowbell, synth bass, robot lead line and vowels, stab rhythm and chords; electro house kick, clap, offbeat hat, filtered bass line, stab rhythm, clap build and its velocity ramp; gates of the 40-bar electro form (intro, build, drop, break, drop2). Import with atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/dnb-electro:atoms-electro").

boom808.doc: 808-style kick: long sine boom at 47 Hz, gentle pitch drop

clap808.doc: 808-style clap: band-passed noise at 1.1 kHz, 0.2 s tail

cowbell808.doc: 808-style cowbell: two squares a fifth apart (play [c#5,g#5]), band-passed at 900 Hz

electroBass.doc: electro-funk synth bass: square, resonant low-pass blip, short

vocoLead.doc: vocoder-style robot lead: saw through a vowel formant (vary .vowel per note); a formant filter, not a carrier/modulator vocoder

robotStab.doc: robot stab: square chord, vowel formant, filter blip

filterBass.doc: electro house filtered saw bass: resonant low-pass with a 3-octave envelope, then drive

sawStab.doc: supersaw stab: unison 7, detune 0.35, spread 0.6, no sustain, filter blip (duck it from the kick: glyphcore/edm sidechain on the kick, ducked(3) here)

kick.doc: electro-funk kick: 1, the and of 2... (an electro-funk style, not a transcription)

leadVowel.doc: lead vowel sweep, one vowel per beat

chords.doc: electro chords, one per bar: Fm, Db, Eb, Cm (i, VI, VII, v)

stabs.doc: stab rhythm (struct over el.chords): offbeats and a push into the next bar

ehBass.doc: electro house bass on the offbeat 8ths (the kick's gaps)

ehStabs.doc: stabs on the offbeats, where the pump has let go

intro.doc: intro (electro-funk): bars 1-8 (form: intro 8, build 8, drop 8, break 8, drop 2 8 = 40 bars = 75 s at 128 bpm)

vacuum.doc: the last half bar before each drop

recipes.title: Electro-funk 808 beat
recipes.intent: Long 808 boom, clap on 2 and 4, 16th hats with accents and a two-bar cowbell: breakbeat electro.

recipes.title: 808-style kick
recipes.intent: A long sine boom with a gentle pitch drop on the electro-funk kick pattern.

recipes.title: 808-style cowbell
recipes.intent: Two squares a fifth apart through a band-pass, on a two-bar pattern.

recipes.title: Electro-funk bass
recipes.intent: Square bass with a resonant filter blip on a syncopated line.

recipes.title: Vocoder-style robot lead
recipes.intent: Saw through a vowel formant that changes every beat (a, e, i, o): a robot voice without a vocoder.

recipes.title: Robot stabs
recipes.intent: Square chords through a vowel formant on an offbeat stab rhythm.

recipes.title: Electro house filtered bass
recipes.intent: Resonant saw bass with a 3-octave filter envelope and drive on the offbeat 8ths.

recipes.title: Sidechained supersaw stabs
recipes.intent: A four-on-the-floor kick ducks the supersaw stabs and the bass on orbit 3 (glyphcore/edm sidechain on the kick, ducked on the targets: superdough duckorbit), so the stabs land where the pump lets go.

recipes.title: Clap build (8 bars)
recipes.intent: Electro house clap build on the shared roll grammar: density doubles toward the drop (glyphcore/edm ec.roll8) while the velocity ramps up (ec.rollVel8).

syntax.title: Sidechain pump: kick ducks the stabs and the bass (audio rate)
syntax.code:
setcpm(128/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/dnb-electro:atoms-electro")
// racks: pack:glyphcore/edm:racks-edm-core (sidechain, ducked)
$: s(atoms.el.ehKick).hook("houseKick | sidechain(3, 0.8, 0.18)")   // the duck sits on the kick voice: orbit 3 ducks
$: note(atoms.el.chords).struct(atoms.el.ehStabs).hook("sawStab | ducked(3)")
$: note(atoms.el.ehBass).hook("filterBass | ducked(3)")

syntax.title: Pattern-level duck from a kick tap (.wire)
syntax.code:
setcpm(128/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/dnb-electro:atoms-electro")
kick: s(atoms.el.ehKick).hook("houseKick").tap("kick")
pad: note(atoms.el.chords).hook("bigChords").wire("gain", "kick:env", { range: [1, 0.3], op: "mul", r: 0.16 })   // the pad follows the kick envelope, no orbit needed

syntax.title: Electro-funk: 808 kit, robot lead, vocoder-style vowels
